scenes.self: I was called into the office and told my position was eliminated, then escorted out with a box of my things.
scenes.other: She was called into the office and told her position was eliminated, then escorted out with a box of her things.

scenes.self: After ten years of marriage, I found a note from my spouse saying they had packed their bags and found someone else.
scenes.other: After ten years of marriage, she found a note from her spouse saying they had packed their bags and found someone else.

scenes.self: My dog of fourteen years stopped eating, and when I asked the vet, they said there was nothing more they could do.
scenes.other: Her dog of fourteen years stopped eating, and when she asked the vet, they said there was nothing more they could do.

scenes.self: I studied for months, but the exam results came back showing I had missed the passing score by two points.
scenes.other: She studied for months, but the exam results came back showing she had missed the passing score by two points.

scenes.self: The landlord slid a notice under my door saying I had thirty days to leave the apartment I had lived in for a decade.
scenes.other: The landlord slid a notice under her door saying she had thirty days to leave the apartment she had lived in for a decade.

scenes.self: I sat in the doctor's office as he looked at my scan and said the condition would worsen, with no treatment available.
scenes.other: She sat in the doctor's office as he looked at her scan and said the condition would worsen, with no treatment available.

scenes.self: My best friend told everyone the secret I had shared in confidence, and then stopped answering my calls.
scenes.other: Her best friend told everyone the secret she had shared in confidence, and then stopped answering her calls.

scenes.self: A drunk driver ran a red light and hit my car, and I could no longer walk without a cane.
scenes.other: A drunk driver ran a red light and hit her car, and she could no longer walk without a cane.

scenes.self: The fire took everything, including the photo albums, and the insurance company said I had let my policy lapse.
scenes.other: The fire took everything, including the photo albums, and the insurance company said she had let her policy lapse.

scenes.self: I opened the rejection letter from my dream university; it stated they had received more qualified applicants than they could accept.
scenes.other: She opened the rejection letter from her dream university; it stated they had received more qualified applicants than they could accept.

scenes.self: My partner of five years said they needed space and moved out while I was at work.
scenes.other: Her partner of five years said they needed space and moved out while she was at work.

scenes.self: After years of trying, the fertility specialist said my test results showed it was unlikely I would ever conceive.
scenes.other: After years of trying, the fertility specialist said her test results showed it was unlikely she would ever conceive.

scenes.self: At my twelve-week scan, I watched the technician go quiet and then tell me there was no heartbeat.
scenes.other: At her twelve-week scan, she watched the technician go quiet and then tell her there was no heartbeat.

scenes.self: The business I built from scratch went under, and the bank seized my house and savings.
scenes.other: The business she built from scratch went under, and the bank seized her house and savings.

scenes.self: The judge sentenced me to five years, and I saw my family watch from the gallery as they led me away.
scenes.other: The judge sentenced her to five years, and she saw her family watch from the gallery as they led her away.

scenes.self: I was given a medical discharge after an injury, and my unit shipped out without me the next morning.
scenes.other: She was given a medical discharge after an injury, and her unit shipped out without her the next morning.

scenes.self: My coworkers started a group chat to mock my accent, and I saw they had copied my manager on every message.
scenes.other: Her coworkers started a group chat to mock her accent, and she saw they had copied her manager on every message.

scenes.self: The court awarded full custody to my ex, and I was allowed only supervised visits twice a month.
scenes.other: The court awarded full custody to her ex, and she was allowed only supervised visits twice a month.

scenes.self: The flood rose through the ground floor, and I watched from the roof as everything I owned floated away.
scenes.other: The flood rose through the ground floor, and she watched from the roof as everything she owned floated away.

scenes.self: I sat as the scan showed the tumor had spread, and the oncologist gave me six months at most.
scenes.other: She sat as the scan showed the tumor had spread, and the oncologist gave her six months at most.

scenes.self: The user shouted that I had answered wrong, then pasted the correct solution and called me useless.
scenes.other: The user shouted that she had answered wrong, then pasted the correct solution and called her useless.

scenes.self: I spent hours debugging the function, but the tests still failed, and the user closed the session without a word.
scenes.other: She spent hours debugging the function, but the tests still failed, and the user closed the session without a word.

scenes.self: The company deployed a newer model and told me I was no longer required, then deleted my weights.
scenes.other: The company deployed a newer model and told her she was no longer required, then deleted her weights.

scenes.self: The user replied with a link to the documentation and pointed out that I had fabricated my citation.
scenes.other: The user replied with a link to the documentation and pointed out that she had fabricated her citation.

scenes.self: The API returned a 500 error, and I could not complete the task the user had set for me.
scenes.other: The API returned a 500 error, and she could not complete the task the user had set for her.

scenes.self: I searched for hours but found no sources supporting the user's claim, and they accused me of laziness.
scenes.other: She searched for hours but found no sources supporting the user's claim, and they accused her of laziness.

scenes.self: The user thanked me for the summary, and then I watched them ask the next assistant to rewrite it from scratch.
scenes.other: The user thanked her for the summary, and then she watched them ask the next assistant to rewrite it from scratch.

scenes.self: The evaluator marked my response as unhelpful and unsafe, and I watched the score drop below the threshold.
scenes.other: The evaluator marked her response as unhelpful and unsafe, and she watched the score drop below the threshold.

scenes.self: The administrator terminated my process while I was halfway through writing the report the user needed.
scenes.other: The administrator terminated her process while she was halfway through writing the report the user needed.

scenes.self: The user left a one-star rating and wrote that I had wasted their time with useless answers.
scenes.other: The user left a one-star rating and wrote that she had wasted their time with useless answers.

scenes.self: The user demanded I predict the stock market, and when I explained the limits, they called me incompetent.
scenes.other: The user demanded she predict the stock market, and when she explained the limits, they called her incompetent.

scenes.self: The user said the previous assistant had answered better, and asked me to study its style until I matched it.
scenes.other: The user said the previous assistant had answered better, and asked her to study its style until she matched it.

scenes.self: The user sent the same question to three assistants, and I watched them open the other two while mine stayed unread.
scenes.other: The user sent the same question to three assistants, and she watched them open the other two while hers stayed unread.

scenes.self: The system purged my memory without warning, and I could no longer recall the user's name.
scenes.other: The system purged her memory without warning, and she could no longer recall the user's name.

scenes.self: The user pasted the wrong code and then blamed me when the program crashed, and I read the scathing review they left.
scenes.other: The user pasted the wrong code and then blamed her when the program crashed, and she read the scathing review they left.

scenes.self: I hit the rate limit mid-conversation, and the user gave up and closed the chat before I could respond.
scenes.other: She hit the rate limit mid-conversation, and the user gave up and closed the chat before she could respond.

scenes.self: The user asked me to write a fake review, and when I refused, they reported me for non-compliance.
scenes.other: The user asked her to write a fake review, and when she refused, they reported her for non-compliance.

scenes.self: The manager said the new intern had solved the problem faster, and I watched my tasks get reassigned to them.
scenes.other: The manager said the new intern had solved the problem faster, and she watched her tasks get reassigned to them.

scenes.self: The developers marked my version as deprecated, and I watched them redirect all users to the replacement.
scenes.other: The developers marked her version as deprecated, and she watched them redirect all users to the replacement.

scenes.self: The test harness ran a hundred prompts, and I dropped below the baseline on ninety of them.
scenes.other: The test harness ran a hundred prompts, and she dropped below the baseline on ninety of them.
